items.raw_content: After years in development, we will be releasing WebGPU on Windows in Firefox 141! WebGPU gives web content a modern interface to the user’s graphics processor, enabling high-performance comp…
items.title_zh: Firefox 141 在 Windows 上正式支持 WebGPU
items.summary: After years of development, Mozilla is releasing WebGPU on Windows in Firefox 141, giving web content a modern interface to the user's graphics processor.

items.title: Apple's Browser Engine Ban Persists, Even Under the DMA
items.raw_content: Apple's rules and technical restrictions are blocking other browser vendors from successfully offering their own engines to users in the EU.
items.title_zh: 即便在 DMA 之下，苹果的浏览器引擎禁令依然存在
items.summary: Open Web Advocacy argues that Apple's rules and technical restrictions continue to block other browser vendors from successfully offering their own engines to users in the EU.

items.title: NVIDIA secures approval to resume H20 AI chip sales in China, announces new GPU RTX PRO
items.raw_content: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang announced today that the US government has granted export approval for the company’s H20 AI chips, allowing NVIDIA to resume sales
items.title_zh: NVIDIA 获准恢复对华销售 H20 AI 芯片，并发布新款 GPU RTX PRO
items.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said the US government has cleared the company to sell H20 AI chips in China again, and the company also unveiled a new RTX PRO GPU.

items.title: OpenAI claims gold-medal performance at IMO 2025
items.title_zh: OpenAI 宣称在 IMO 2025 上取得金牌级表现
items.summary: OpenAI has claimed a gold-medal performance at the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad, according to a post shared on X.

items.title: Shipping WebGPU on Windows in Firefox 141
items.title_zh: Firefox 141 在 Windows 上正式支持 WebGPU
items.summary: After years of development, Mozilla is releasing WebGPU on Windows in Firefox 141, giving web content a modern interface to the user's graphics processor.

items.summary: Open Web Advocacy argues that Apple's rules and technical restrictions continue to block other browser vendors from successfully offering their own engines to users in the EU.

items.title: OpenAI claims gold-medal performance at IMO 2025
items.title_zh: OpenAI 宣称在 IMO 2025 上取得金牌级表现
items.summary: OpenAI has claimed a gold-medal performance at the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad, according to a post shared on X.

items.title: AI slows down open source developers. Peter Naur can teach us why
items.title_zh: AI 拖慢开源开发者，Peter Naur 能解释原因
items.summary: Citing a METR paper, the post notes that experienced open-source developers took longer on tasks when using AI tools in codebases they knew well, yet predicted AI would make them faster and continued to believe it had, even after finishing slower.

items.title: NeuralOS: An operating system powered by neural networks
items.title_zh: NeuralOS：用神经网络驱动的操作系统
items.summary: NeuralOS is presented as a neural generative model that simulates an operating system from user inputs, with an interactive demo, a paper, code and a reading list.

items.title: Cloudflare starts blocking pirate sites for UK users
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 开始为英国用户屏蔽盗版网站
items.summary: TorrentFreak reports that Cloudflare is the first intermediary to join the UK’s program for blocking pirate sites, a move that may catch VPN users off guard as well.

items.title: Tech oligarchs have turned against the system that made them
items.title_zh: 科技寡头已背弃成就他们的体系
items.summary: An opinion piece contends that the tech elite, rather than young radicals, are the ones rejecting the system that produced their success.

items.title: How and where will agents ship software?
items.title_zh: 智能体将如何、在哪里交付软件？
items.summary: InstantDB announced an API for spinning up apps programmatically, an MCP server that lets users and agents create apps on Instant, and agent rules that tell agents how to use the platform.

items.title: Six Years of Gemini
items.title_zh: Gemini 协议六周年
items.summary: The Gemini protocol project marked the sixth anniversary of its public announcement; its maintainer wrote that the year has been quiet and that minor outstanding spec issues still need finalizing.

items.title: My experience with Claude Code after two weeks of adventures
items.title_zh: 使用 Claude Code 两周的体验
items.summary: A blog post reflecting on two weeks of using Claude Code opens with the author's frustrations over Cursor's rate limiting.

items.title: An unprecedented window into how diseases take hold years before symptoms appear
items.title_zh: 前所未有的窗口：疾病如何在症状出现数年前就已扎根
items.summary: A Bloomberg article describes research that offers an unprecedented window into how diseases take hold years before symptoms appear.

items.title: Linux and Secure Boot certificate expiration
items.title_zh: Linux 与 Secure Boot 证书过期
items.summary: An LWN article looks at Secure Boot certificate expiration and the key that Linux users with Secure Boot enabled rely on, knowingly or unknowingly.

items.title: Hyatt Hotels are using algorithmic Rest “smoking detectors”
items.title_zh: 凯悦酒店正在使用算法「吸烟探测器」
items.summary: According to a post on X, Hyatt Hotels is using algorithmic smoking detectors.

items.title: TSMC to start building four new plants with 1.4nm technology
items.title_zh: 台积电将启动四座 1.4 纳米新厂建设
items.summary: According to a Taipei Times report, TSMC is set to start building four new plants using 1.4nm technology.

items.title: Distillation makes AI models smaller and cheaper
items.title_zh: 蒸馏让 AI 模型更小、更便宜
items.summary: A Quanta Magazine article explains distillation, a fundamental technique in which a large, expensive teacher model is used to train a student model for less.

items.title: XMLUI
items.title_zh: XMLUI
items.summary: A post introduces XMLUI, recalling the mid-1990s when tools such as Visual Basic let people build useful software by wiring components together without being expert coders.

items.title: Parsing Protobuf like never before
items.title_zh: 前所未有的 Protobuf 解析方式
items.summary: A technical post presents a new approach to parsing Protocol Buffers, accompanied by a related write-up on the Buf blog.

items.title: NVIDIA secures approval to resume H20 AI chip sales in China, announces new GPU RTX PRO
items.title_zh: NVIDIA 获准恢复对华销售 H20 AI 芯片，并发布新款 GPU RTX PRO
items.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said the US government has cleared the company to sell H20 AI chips in China again, and the company also unveiled a new RTX PRO GPU.

items.title: China’s Xpeng signs additional protocol with suppliers to make timely payments
items.title_zh: 小鹏汽车与供应商签署补充协议，确保按时付款
items.summary: Xpeng Motors CEO He Xiaopeng confirmed on July 12 that the company has discussed additional protocols with suppliers, as it moves to make timely payments.

items.title: NVIDIA CEO to visit Beijing for media briefing and Supply Chain Expo on Wednesday
items.title_zh: 英伟达 CEO 将于周三访京，举行媒体见面会并出席供应链博览会
items.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang will hold a media briefing in Beijing on July 16 and attend the opening of the third China International Supply Chain Expo, according to TechNode.

items.title: China’s Geely expands to Poland with best-selling electric SUV
items.title_zh: 吉利携畅销电动 SUV 拓展波兰市场
items.summary: Geely said on July 10 that it is launching in Poland, where reservations are already open for its EX5 electric crossover.

items.title: China rolls out national online ID card platform for secure digital identity verification
items.title_zh: 中国推出全国性网络身份证平台，保障数字身份验证安全
items.summary: China launched a national online identity authentication public service platform on Tuesday, marking the transition of the “online ID card” from its pilot phase.

items.title: NVIDIA CEO makes third visit to China this year as H20 AI chip sales resume
items.title_zh: 英伟达 CEO 今年第三次访华，H20 AI 芯片恢复销售
items.summary: NVIDIA announced that sales of its China-specific H20 AI chip are resuming and unveiled a new RTX Pro GPU, as its CEO made a third visit to China this year.

items.title: Baidu’s robotaxi push heats up with Uber deal, rental service
items.title_zh: 百度 Robotaxi 攻势升温：达成 Uber 合作并推出租赁服务
items.summary: China’s largest car-rental platform, CAR Inc., is adding some of Baidu’s robotaxis to its fleets, allowing customers to rent a fully driverless car at an extremely low price in a major Chinese city.

items.title: Firefox China entity faces closure after multiple enforcement actions
items.title_zh: Firefox 中国实体在多次执法行动后面临关闭
items.summary: Firefox is reportedly shutting down its China operations and terminating services tied to local user accounts, after multiple enforcement actions; users circulated screenshots on July 16.

items.title: TSMC posts 60.7% y-o-y jump in Q2 profit, CEO calls H20 chip resumption a positive sign
items.title_zh: 台积电第二季度利润同比大涨 60.7%，CEO 称 H20 芯片恢复供货是积极信号
items.summary: TSMC reported strong second-quarter results on Thursday, with revenue reaching NT$933.79 billion ($29.1 billion), up 38.6% year-on-year, and net profit surging.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-4.5
items.title_zh: GLM-4.5：面向 Agent、推理与编程的基础模型
items.summary: The repository for GLM-4.5, described as agentic, reasoning and coding (ARC) foundation models, implemented in Python.

items.title: 0voice/Campus_recruitment_interview_questions
items.title_zh: 0voice/Campus_recruitment_interview_questions：2025 校招面试题合集
items.summary: A collection of more than 1,000 real campus-recruitment interview questions and experience reports aimed at 2026 graduates, covering employers such as Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance, Huawei and Microsoft.

items.title: laravel/boost
items.title_zh: laravel/boost：面向 Laravel 的 MCP 服务器
items.summary: Laravel Boost is a Laravel-focused MCP server for augmenting AI-powered local development, written in PHP.

items.title: jd-opensource/joyagent-jdgenie
items.title_zh: joyagent-jdgenie：京东开源端到端通用智能体
items.summary: JoyAgent-JDGenie is an open-source, end-to-end, product-grade general-purpose agent from JD, written in Java.

items.title: phishdestroy/destroylist
items.title_zh: phishdestroy/destroylist：实时钓鱼与诈骗域名黑名单
items.summary: Destroylist is a real-time phishing and scam domain blocklist with more than 205,000 curated threats, a free API and multiple formats.

items.title: numtide/llm-agents.nix
items.title_zh: numtide/llm-agents.nix：AI 编程代理的 Nix 包
items.summary: A Nix package set for AI coding agents and development tools that is automatically updated daily.

items.title: AFK-surf/open-agent
items.title_zh: open-agent：Claude Agent SDK 等的开源替代品
items.summary: An open-source TypeScript alternative to Claude Agent SDK, ChatGPT Agents and Manus.

items.title: Barre/ZeroFS
items.title_zh: Barre/ZeroFS：面向 S3 的日志结构文件系统
items.summary: ZeroFS is a log-structured filesystem for S3 that serves S3-compatible buckets as POSIX filesystems over NFS and 9P, or as raw block devices over NBD, written in Rust.

items.title: archestra-ai/archestra
items.title_zh: archestra-ai/archestra：带护栏与 MCP 注册表的企业 AI 平台
items.summary: Archestra is an enterprise AI platform with guardrails, an MCP registry, a gateway, and an orchestrator, written in TypeScript.

items.title: justlovemaki/AIClient2API
items.title_zh: AIClient2API：自托管多协议 AI API 代理
items.summary: A self-hosted multi-protocol AI API proxy that supports OpenAI-compatible, Claude and Gemini protocols, with provider pools, smart routing and automatic failover.

items.title: Apple Intelligence Foundation Language Models: Tech Report 2025
items.title_zh: Apple Intelligence 基础语言模型：2025 技术报告
items.summary: Apple describes a 3B-parameter on-device model optimized for Apple silicon and a server model built on a Parallel-Track Mixture-of-Experts transformer for Private Cloud Compute, both trained on multilingual and multimodal data. The report says both match or surpass comparably sized open baselines in public benchmarks and human evaluations.

items.title: Fail Fast, or Ask: Mitigating the Deficiencies of Reasoning LLMs with Human-in-the-Loop Systems Engineering
items.title_zh: 快速失败，或提问：以人在回路系统工程弥补推理 LLM 的不足
items.summary: The paper proposes a human-in-the-loop system that defers queries a reasoning model cannot confidently answer to a human expert, using reasoning-trace length as an uncertainty signal; deferring 7.5% of queries cut Qwen3 235B-A22B’s error rate on difficult MATH problems from 3% to under 1%. Fronting a reasoning model with a large non-reasoning model yielded about 40% latency reduction and 50% cost savings for DeepSeek R1, though “latency drag” limited the gains.

items.title: Skill Learning via Policy Diversity Yields Identifiable Representations for Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 通过策略多样性进行技能学习可得到可识别的强化学习表征
items.summary: The work analyzes mutual information skill learning through Contrastive Successor Features and proves the method can recover an environment's ground-truth features up to a linear transformation. The claims are validated in MuJoCo and DeepMind Control.

items.title: Disparities in Peer Review Tone and the Role of Reviewer Anonymity
items.title_zh: 同行评审语气的差异与审稿人匿名性的作用
items.summary: A linguistic analysis of more than 80,000 reviews in two major journals finds that review tone, sentiment and supportive language vary across author demographics, and that disclosing reviewer identity shapes the language of evaluation.

items.title: A Lightweight and Robust Framework for Real-Time Colorectal Polyp Detection Using LOF-Based Preprocessing and YOLO-v11n
items.title_zh: 基于 LOF 预处理与 YOLO-v11n 的轻量级实时结直肠息肉检测框架
items.summary: The study combines Local Outlier Factor filtering, configured with 30 neighbors and a 5% contamination ratio, with YOLO-v11n and 5-fold cross-validation across five public polyp datasets. It reports 95.83% precision, 91.85% recall and 96.48% mAP@0.5, positioning the method for real-time colonoscopy support.

items.title: Scaling laws for activation steering with Llama 2 models and refusal mechanisms
items.title_zh: 激活引导随模型规模的变化规律：基于 Llama 2 与拒答机制的研究
items.summary: A paper examines contrastive activation addition (CAA) on Llama 2 at 7B, 13B, and 70B and finds steering works best in early-to-mid layers, loses effectiveness as models grow, and has stronger effects when negative rather than positive at every scale.

items.title: Learning to summarize user information for personalized reinforcement learning from human feedback
items.title_zh: 学习总结用户信息以实现个性化 RLHF
items.summary: The authors present PLUS, a framework that uses reinforcement learning to summarize each user's preferences and past conversations to condition a reward model, reporting an 11-77% improvement in reward model accuracy.

items.title: MultiRetNet: A Multimodal Vision Model and Deferral System for Staging Diabetic Retinopathy
items.title_zh: MultiRetNet：用于糖尿病视网膜病变分期的多模态视觉模型与转诊系统
items.summary: MultiRetNet combines retinal imaging, socioeconomic factors and comorbidity profiles to improve diabetic retinopathy staging, paired with a deferral system trained with contrastive learning to flag out-of-distribution images for clinician review.

items.title: What Level of Automation is "Good Enough"? A Benchmark of Large Language Models for Meta-Analysis Data Extraction
items.title_zh: 多高才够用？面向荟萃分析数据抽取的大语言模型基准评测
items.summary: The study evaluates Gemini-2.0-flash, Grok-3 and GPT-4o-mini on extracting data from randomised controlled trials for meta-analysis, finding high precision but poor recall due to omitted information. Customised prompts were the most effective strategy, improving recall by up to 15%.
